question: free_tier.unit needs a term for an unpublished allowance reported only as a share remaining (a quota counted in agent work or token cost, refreshed on a window), such as 'quota-share'.
why: coding-subs/antigravity, coding-subs/claude-code and coding-subs/chatgpt-plans use 'unlimited' for such a quota, which reads as no cap; this unit set antigravity to 'mixed' with the true unit in free_tier.stated, per docs/conventions/README.md, until a rules session adds a term.
